ISAAC_FS_TRACE=1 proves the archives are never fopen'd (16 FS probes in a whole boot: save-dir setup, savedatapath.txt, log.txt, kage_mount_points.dat x2, two Lua scripts, options.ini). The decision is inside the guest: 0x00a179c0 -> 0x00a17180 -> 0x00a16c60 resolves relative paths ONLY through a per-mount-root std::map keyed by the path hash at 0x00a159d0. Read back with ISAAC_DUMP32 from the trapped run: mount-root vector [0x00c379e8]=0x00d09ca4 / [0x00c379ec]=0x00d09ca8 = exactly ONE root; that root's map at 0x00d09c30 has _Mysize == 0; loaded-archive count [0x00c37b14] == 0. The root is mounted unconditionally by 0x009abbd0 (from 0x009aa040 at 0x009aa74c) from the empty string at 0x00b1a4ec, and mounting scans nothing (0x00a16e00 is 54 insns, no FS API).
